main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The material world is an illusion
header_desc: The union between science and spirituality occurs when we understand that the Gnostic gospels, written nearly two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The demiurgic EGO has mass and creates the tempo-material illusion; to counteract it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and spaceless: the ONE, whose guidance—followed with the heart—allows us to ignite the divine spark
left_title: The Return of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth to the Kingdom of Light
left_body: In general relativity, matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego has mass and exerts its own gravity: its density deforms your inner fabric and weaves the temporal and material illusion of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to understand that the statement ``the Father and I are one'' is a call to dissolve the ``false self'' to return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells: the timeless and divine reality of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but rather a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Pistis Sophia and the demiurge Yaldabaoth: consciousness manifests through two fundamental states—the spiritual |ONE⟩ ❤️ and the material |EGO⟩ 🧠—. This demonstrates that free will is a fundamental property of the cosmos, independent of dogmas or religious beliefs, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force pulls us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: The prison ┻ in which you sleep 🧠 has its doors open. You just need to turn the map ✝️ to awaken ❤️
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The flight of science and spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, the breakdown of Einstein's simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual assembly Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the Primary Consciousness and the Timeless Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi finding (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as a confinement of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to liberate the inner spark from the demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and The Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The demiurge Yaldabaoth—also known as the great architect of matter—is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as a cognitive prison of the ego, versus the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the system of imperial slavery.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the immensity of the cosmos—with its more than two trillion galaxies—it is there that the phrase of Jesus resonates most strongly: “The Father and I are one”. Could this have an hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flowing beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfactory... it does not make much sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
